g.text: UV DRIVER: two series Vishay LEDs,200mV/3.65R=54.79mA nominal. CTRL static; no EasyScale/PWM.

g.desc: UV DRIVER: two series Vishay LEDs,200mV/3.65R=54.79mA nominal. CTRL static; no EasyScale/PWM.

g.text: Each LED has only two electrical terminals. Cathode mark must match pin1. Local SW loop short; no HV hinge wires.

g.desc: Each LED has only two electrical terminals. Cathode mark must match pin1. Local SW loop short; no HV hinge wires.

g.text: Cathode FET interrupts LED current on CTRL low; input cuts are on safety board.

g.desc: Cathode FET interrupts LED current on CTRL low; input cuts are on safety board.

g.text: OUTPUT:4.7uF50V,100k bleeder,1M/68k monitor. Output can remain charged after light stops.

g.desc: OUTPUT:4.7uF50V,100k bleeder,1M/68k monitor. Output can remain charged after light stops.

g.text: Require >=1uF effective output at39V/temp/age. OVP37..39V; measure switch ringing. FB/VOUT filters10k/100nF.

g.text: NTC controller owns pullup/filter. 67L045 thermal cutoff plus separate gold lid contact form hardware loop.
